entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Were you just going to go to sleep[n]without even wondering where I was?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I take it the chief told you about Futaba,[n]and then you guys disbanded in relief[n]for now.
How do you know that?
Where were you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You can't underestimate my intel-[n]gathering skills, you know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I was checking out the chief's house.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I didn't think our Alibaba would be so[n]young...
Young?
What was she like?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, she's probably about the same age[n]as you guys.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At least her voice was pretty young-[n]sounding. Oh, and she had long hair,[n]too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She had long hair and a pretty young-[n]sounding voice.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... I say young, but I think she's[n]probably about the same age as you[n]guys.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At the very least, she's surely no amateur.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She completely overheard your[n]conversation with the chief, and she[n]can hack into our chats too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even if she can't take Medjed down[n]directly, she might have some kind of[n]lead on them.
Just who is she?
What an odd girl.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In any case, we'll need to rely on Futaba[n]to get closer to Medjed.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's meet up again tomorrow. How[n]about we do it in here? It's way too hot[n]outside...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, make sure you let everyone[n]know.
